html:
News Digest:

The US consumer price index (CPI) rose by 0.3% in April, down from 1.2% in March, registering its first decline since August 2021, official data showed.

 

Takeaway:

The CPI’s annualised rate of growth in April came in at 8.3%, down from 8.5% a month ago, but still close to a 40-year high.

 

 

End Notes
Source: https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/may/11/us-inflation-consumer-price-index-figures
